Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.math

Class TokenEquation

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.math.TokenEquation
public final class TokenEquation extends SceneObject
Structured equation with stable token identities. Matching tokens move continuously; removed tokens shrink away and new tokens grow in. This is a presentation model, not a CAS.
